title: Explicit exact finite quotient realization on a pro-etale slice
statement: For X,d,V,U,W,f and n as in [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-tower-data], restrict fixed quotient-coefficient module sheaves from U to W, transport along the pro-etale slice equivalence, apply associated module sheafification along the locally bijective finite-scalar unit, and restrict scalars along the completed-ring projection. This gives an explicit exact functor and its termwise derived localization. Include the local bijectivity, equivalence and exactness proofs; no functor is chosen from an existence assertion.

def finitePerfectAdicScalarRealization (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (V : X.Etale) (U : V.left.ProEt) (W : X.ProEt)
    (f : W ⟶ finitePerfectAdicChartObject V U) (n : ℕ) :
    DerivedCategory (Sheaf (ProEt.topology U.left)
      (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))))) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} ((completedAdicRing X d).over W))
